title: Evaluation with a unique output
statement: Let $F$ be a layered circuit over $\alpha$ with input type $\mathrm{inp}$ and a unique output, and let $xs:\mathrm{inp}\to\alpha$ be an input assignment. The circuit's scalar evaluation equals the value of the node in its last layer corresponding to the unique output.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit with the stated alphabet, input type, and output type
The output type has exactly one element
